env_lead: The same diagnosis as jgates doctor: runtimes, binaries and tool versions against the lockfile. Nothing is installed or downloaded here, only when preparing.
env_not_ready: Environment with pending items: {absent} absent, {incompatible} incompatible.
env_three_states: Environment ready, valid plan and approved result are different states: this screen only speaks about the first.
env_prepare_versions_value: {tool} installed: {installed}; adapter range: {range}; pinned in the lockfile: {pinned}
env_prepare_network_value: Will download the rules {ref} from {url}. It is the only stage that uses the network; later runs use the stored copy.
env_prepare_note: The copy stays in the JGates data folder, identified by its hash, and the hash goes to the project lockfile.
env_prepare_image_local: None: the image {image} is already in the container runtime; only the lockfile is written.
env_prepare_image_pull: Will run docker pull {image} ({hosts}), because the given image is not in the runtime.
env_prepare_image_note: The image is pinned by digest (or id) in the project lockfile, with the version from the label; the plan uses only that image.
